items.title: U.S. Charges Canadian Man in Alleged Hack of University Supercomputers
items.summary: A Canadian man was extradited to the U.S. to face charges over hacking universities and hijacking their computers to mine cryptocurrency. items.title: Two Barracuda ESG Flaws Could Be Combined for Full Root Access; Patches Released
items.summary: Barracuda patched two flaws that can be chained to give attackers root access to Email Security Gateway appliances. items.title: Cyberattack Hits French Blood Banks as Hackers Target Refrigeration Systems Across Europe
items.summary: Cyberattacks disrupted refrigeration monitoring systems at three French blood banks, amid similar attacks targeting European supermarkets. A cyberattack has hit three regional blood banks in France, disrupting systems used to monitor and control refrigerated storage facilities.
